prose: Meta and Apple announced a collaboration so developers can run Muse Spark Open locally on Apple's top Mac Studios with M5 Ultra. The article frames it as a thaw between Tim Cook's and Mark Zuckerberg's companies now that John Ternus leads Apple, with AI as common ground.
highlights: Meta and Apple tuned Muse Spark Open for local use on M5 Ultra Macs.
Seen as a sign of cooperation under Apple's new CEO.
